title: Signed Scope Additions in Milestone Billing — Professional Services Projects
content:
On a fixed-fee Professional Services Projects engagement, a signed scope addition is billed exactly once, in full, with the milestone that delivers it, and never through a schedule share.

## Which milestone delivers an addition

A milestone delivers at most one scope addition, the signed scope addition with the highest change order number, when that addition was registered after the date of the latest milestone invoice (or, before any milestone invoice, after the date of the deposit invoice) and no later than the date this milestone was recorded complete.

Every other signed scope addition is billed exactly once as well: one that was the highest-numbered addition in an earlier milestone's window was billed in full with that milestone, and one that shared a milestone's window with a higher-numbered addition is not delivered by any milestone and is billed in full by the final invoice on acceptance, because no schedule share includes it.

## The milestone invoice before retainage

On an engagement carrying signed scope additions, the milestone invoice before retainage is the milestone's schedule share applied to the contract value after the value changes of every signed scope addition have been taken out of it, plus the value change of the addition this milestone delivers, if any, in full. An engagement carrying no signed scope addition is not affected by this clause.

| Engagement carries signed scope additions? | Highest-numbered addition registered in this milestone's window? | Milestone invoice before retainage |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | the schedule share of the contract value without any signed scope addition, plus that addition's value change in full |
| Yes | No | the schedule share of the contract value without any signed scope addition |
| No | not applicable | not affected by this clause |

The window opens after the date of the latest milestone invoice (or of the deposit invoice) and closes on the date this milestone was recorded complete: an addition registered on the date of the latest milestone invoice is outside it, and one registered on the completion date is inside it.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures, schedule share 30 percent)

An engagement with an original value of 40000.00 carries one signed scope addition of 6000.00, so its contract value is 46000.00. The addition was registered after the deposit invoice date and before milestone 1 was recorded complete. Milestone 1: 30 percent of 40000.00, that is 12000.00, plus 6000.00, giving 18000.00. Milestone 2, with no addition registered in its window: 30 percent of 40000.00, that is 12000.00.
